_comment: Item sets only one class can equip, by Wowhead's 'Class:' line on the set's tooltip (the source URL per row). Hand-written. assemble_universe.py drops a piece of one of these sets from every other class's universe, and scripts/check_class_restricted_sets.py fails pnpm verify if one is left in. classId is the common.proto Class enum, which matches Wowhead's class ids. Only the Naxxramas Tier 3 sets are listed: Wowhead tags Dungeon Set 2 (setIds 511-519) with an armor type and no class, so any class that wears that armor can equip them. Decided at stage-gate cleanup-upstream-footprint, decision-log 2026-10-08T23:36Z; ticket 576.
